title: Removed Public-Key-Pins header present
description: The response sends `Public-Key-Pins`, a header that was removed from the specification after browsers stopped implementing it. It now adds bytes to every response and no protection, and a pinning mistake is not mitigated by anything the header claims.
remediation: Remove Public-Key-Pins and rely on HSTS plus certificate transparency monitoring. If pinning is required, implement it in the client rather than through a removed header.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the removed header; it does not evaluate the pin list and cannot say whether any client still honours it.
